content.short: Virtuals Protocol is a decentralized infrastructure for creating and tokenizing autonomous AI agents.
content.description: Virtuals Protocol is an innovative platform that enables the creation, tokenization, and co-ownership of autonomous AI agents designed for the digital economy. These AI 'workers' can interact across various platforms—including social media, gaming environments, and messaging apps—to generate revenue and provide value. Represented on-chain by tokens, these agents have persistent personalities and their own digital wallets, allowing for a new era of decentralized AI-driven commerce. The protocol provides a launchpad for the next generation of interactive, autonomous entities that bridge the gap between AI and Web3.
content.meta: Virtuals Protocol provides infrastructure for tokenized, autonomous AI agents. Discover Virtuals Protocol and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
